snippet.title: New Multiplayer Co-Op RPG!
snippet.description:
Teaser Trailer for The Freeblades, an Online Multiplayer Dungeon RPG with MMO Progression and no Pay-2-Win mechanics!

Wishlist on Steam and join the discord server to be eligible for the upcoming closed Demo Testing!
Discord - https://discord.gg/ZTb7juM
Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3983160/The_Freeblades/
